attributes.board_name: Georgia State Board of Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: No prior approval needed; activities relevant to OT practice beyond entry level. At least 12 hours on direct patient care topics through live presentations, formal academic coursework or real-time interactive webinars. Max 10 'general' hours from Level II fieldwork supervision, writing, presentations, pre-recorded/web-based courses, self-study, webinars, videos; these may cover administration, supervision, documentation, QA and research. Excluded: orientation, policy/business meetings, annual compliance training, CPR.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First-time Georgia licensees licensed in the second year of the biennium are exempt for that initial renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Random CE audits. CE may be recorded in CE Broker (Board-approved, free); otherwise all certificates must be attached to the renewal application. Keep documentation at least 4 years from the start of the renewal period.

topics.who: Ethics of occupational therapy practice; may be online; counts toward the 24

rules.notes: Licenses expire March 31 of even-numbered years; late renewal April 1–30 with late fee; from May 1 the license is revoked by operation of law. 1 hour = actual instruction time, excluding meals, breaks, introductions and business meetings. Rule last amended effective July 15, 2026.
